snippet.title: SkinSpotlights
snippet.description:
This channel will showcase the latest Skins coming in League of Legends. Subscribe to keep upto date!

This channel has all the skins up (Oldest and Newest) in 1080p60fps.  Quality over speed, the format will remain the same so you know what to expect every time.
"Final" Spotlights when a skin is 100% finished will be in 4k60fps, Pre-release videos will vary between 4k60fps and 1080p60fps.

EUW Server - Uli

Twitch - http://www.twitch.tv/SkinSpotlights
Weibo - https://m.weibo.com/u/6503851567

You do not have my permission to re-upload any of my videos or video clips. 



Software:
http://skinspotlights.com/
